scripts.quality: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --frozen --group dev ruff format processor scripts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv run --frozen --group dev ruff format --check processor scripts
scripts.lint: eslint . && uv run --frozen --group dev ruff check processor scripts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && uv run --frozen --group dev mypy processor scripts
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply runmaps --config apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc --remote
scripts.test: npm run test:worker && npm run test:processor && npm run test:browser-processor && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:runs-pages
scripts.test:processor: uv run --frozen python -m unittest discover -s processor/tests -p 'test_*.py'
